declare
 nAlertResponse number;
 id_alert ALERT;
begin
/*
** Blk1 - Active Letters, Blk2 - History (Always diplay only)
** Letter code -
** NEW - Show Popup
** If 'Save' - Create row in Blk1
** NULL - Populate Blk2 only
** Disable Blk1
** CODE - Populate Blk1 with max 2 records
** Populate Blk2 with rest of the records
** 
*/

-- set_block_property('valid_letters', insert_allowed, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('valid_letters', update_allowed, PROPERTY_TRUE);

 if :ctrl_block.letter_code = 'NEW' then
 id_alert := find_alert('new_letter_alert');
 if id_null(id_alert) then
 show_error ('9203');
 end if;
 nAlertResponse := show_alert(id_alert);
 if nAlertResponse = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
 :valid_letters.letter_title := null;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
/* Show 'New Letter' Popup */
 show_new_window( 'N' );
 null;
 end if;

 elsif :ctrl_block.letter_code is null then
 set_block_property('valid_letters', insert_allowed, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_block_property('valid_letters', update_allowed, PROPERTY_FALSE);

 set_block_property('valid_letters_hist', default_where, 
 'document_type = decode( :global.letters_for, ' || 
 in_quotes( 'NOTIF' ) || ', ' || in_quotes( 'N' ) || ', ' || in_quotes( 'L' ) || ')');
 go_block( 'valid_letters_hist' );
 execute_query;
 elsif :ctrl_block.letter_code is not null then
 set_block_property('valid_letters', default_where, 
 'letter_code = :ctrl_block.letter_code ' || 
 'and sysdate between eff_date and nvl( term_date, sysdate + 1 )');
 set_block_property('valid_letters_hist', default_where, 
 'letter_code = :ctrl_block.letter_code ' || 
 'and term_date is not null ' || 
 'and term_date <= trunc( sysdate )');
 go_block( 'valid_letters' );
 end if;
end;

declare
 nAlertResponse number;
 id_alert ALERT;

 cursor cur_letter(p_letter_code varchar2) is
 select letter_code, letter_title 
 from valid_letters
 where letter_code = p_letter_code
 and document_type = decode( :global.letters_for, 'NOTIF', 'N', 'L' ) 
 and version_no = (
 select max( a.version_no )
 from valid_letters a
 where a.letter_code = p_letter_code );

begin
/*
** Blk1 - Active Letters, Blk2 - History (Always diplay only)
** Letter code -
** NEW - Show Popup
** If 'Save' - Create row in Blk1
** NULL - Populate Blk2 only
** Disable Blk1
** CODE - Populate Blk1 with max 2 records
** Populate Blk2 with rest of the records
** 
*/
-- show_error('18148'); -- 'Letter code cannot be null'

-- set_block_property('valid_letters', insert_allowed, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('valid_letters', update_allowed, PROPERTY_TRUE);

 if :ctrl_block.letter_code = 'NEW' then
 null;
/*
 id_alert := find_alert('new_letter_alert');
 if id_null(id_alert) then
 show_error ('9203');
 end if;
 nAlertResponse := show_alert(id_alert);
 if nAlertResponse = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
 :valid_letters.letter_title := null;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
-- Show 'New Letter' Popup 
 null;
 end if;
*/
 elsif :ctrl_block.letter_code is null then
 :ctrl_block.letter_title := null;

 set_block_property('valid_letters', insert_allowed, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_block_property('valid_letters', update_allowed, PROPERTY_FALSE);

 set_block_property('valid_letters_hist', default_where, 
 'document_type = decode( :global.letters_for, ' || 
 in_quotes( 'NOTIF' ) || ', ' || in_quotes( 'N' ) || ', ' || in_quotes( 'L' ) || ')');
 elsif :ctrl_block.letter_code is not null then
 open cur_letter(:ctrl_block.letter_code);
 fetch cur_letter
 into :ctrl_block.letter_code, :ctrl_block.letter_title;
 if cur_letter%NOTFOUND then

 else

 'letter_code = :ctrl_block.letter_code ' || 
 'and sysdate between eff_date and nvl( term_date, sysdate + 1 )');
 end if;
 if cur_letter%ISOPEN then

 end if;

 'letter_code = :ctrl_block.letter_code ' || 
 'and term_date is not null ' || 
 'and term_date <= trunc( sysdate )');

end;

RecordGroup.Name: LETTERS_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select a.letter_code, a.letter_title, a.version_no, to_char(a.eff_date,'MM-DD-YYYY') effdate, to_char(a.term_date,'MM-DD-YYYY') termdate
from valid_letters a 
where 
/***
a.version_no = ( select max( b.version_no ) 
 from valid_letters b 
 where a.letter_code = b.letter_code ) 
**/
lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate)
 between eff_date and nvl(term_date, lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate)
+1)
and document_type = decode( :global.letters_for, 'NOTIF', 'N', 'L' ) 
order by a.letter_code
